test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a college entrance test, the average marks obtained by all 30 boys of the class is 5 less than the average marks obtained by all 20 girls of the class. If the average marks of the whole class are 25, then find the ratio of average marks of boys to that of girls.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__
Let average of girls = x, then average of boys = x − 5.

Total Weighted Average = [ (30 × (x − 5)) + (20 × x) ] ÷ 50 = 25.

⇒ 3(x − 5) + 2x = 125 ⇒ 5x − 15 = 125 ⇒ 5x = 140 ⇒ x = 28.

Average of girls = 28, Average of boys = 28 − 5 = 23.

**∴ The correct answer is 23 ∶ 28.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6560cf4979bb7fff193a9cb2420fbefe9c82b33345e6248ee514ae8dd093e4d.png] 
**Given:** Number of **Boys** = 30, Number of **Girls** = 20, **Total Average** = 25.

**Formula:** Total Sum = (Average₁ × N₁) + (Average₂ × N₂)

⇒ Let average marks of girls be G. Then average marks of boys = G − 5.

⇒ Total marks = 30(G − 5) + 20G

⇒ Total students = 30 + 20 = 50

⇒ Total marks = Average × Total students = 25 × 50 = 1250

⇒ 30G − 150 + 20G = 1250

⇒ 50G = 1400

⇒ G = 1400 ÷ 50 = 28

⇒ Average marks of boys = 28 − 5 = 23

⇒ Required Ratio = Boys : Girls = 23 : 28

**∴ The correct answer is 23 ∶ 28.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Formula

Weighted Average = (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where n is the quantity and x is the average of each group.

Alligation Rule

The ratio of the quantities is inversely proportional to the deviations of their averages from the mean average: (Quantity 1 ÷ Quantity 2) = (Avg 2 − Mean) ÷ (Mean − Avg 1).

Average Properties

If every observation is increased or decreased by a constant value 'k', the new average will also increase or decrease by 'k'.</p
